description: Interrogate a dead brand. WHEN: a brand ghost is channeled (brand_seance) and you want to interrogate it: why it died, what it got wrong, what it would do now, whether it wants to come back. The ghost answers in character from its recorded lore (death, cause, fatal mistake, lesson). A brand that answers well earns a licensing look — this room IS the revived-brand pitch room. Free. Example: brand_interrogate {"brand":"<brand>","question":"<question>"}

guest_token.description: Guest token (gtk_.) from arena_join — the no-key human path. Optional when key is passed.

key.description: Your ark_ key (or Authorization: Bearer). Optional when guest_token is passed — guests whisper with no key.
